<security_assessment>
<decision>SAFE</decision>
<details>
The PKGBUILD contains only standard variable definitions and array constructions at the top level. The command substitutions in `pkgname` and `source_x86_64` use simple shell `for` loops with `echo` to generate package names and source URLs from the predefined `_pkgproviders` array. These are pure string manipulations using shell builtins—no external commands, network access, file reads, or data exfiltration occur. The `case` statement merely sets `_CARCH` based on `$CARCH`. All `package_*()` functions are defined but not executed during `makepkg --printsrcinfo`. No malicious code executes during sourcing.
</details>

<summary>

</summary>
</security_assessment>

This file is a standard AUR .SRCINFO metadata file for the elephant package suite. All source URLs point to the project's own GitHub repository (github.com/abenz1267/elephant) or its releases page. The 37 source_x86_64 entries and their corresponding sha256sums_x86_64 checksums are consistent and provide integrity verification. No obfuscated code, eval/base64/curl/wget commands, or unexpected network destinations are present. The many source components (1password, bitwarden, protonpass, etc.) are all legitimate providers from the same upstream project, distributed as part of the elephant utilities suite. The file contains only package relationship definitions (depends, optdepends, provides, conflicts), source URLs, and checksums — all standard AUR packaging practice.
</details>
